name: Yarn Spinner
what_it_is: Narrative game tools for writers and programmers: a screenplay-like dialogue language, compiled and run in Unity, Godot or Unreal Engine.
platforms: Unity, Godot (C# and GDScript), Unreal Engine; browser trial
pricing: Free and paid versions are offered; the opened pages show no price figures.
notable: Games listed on the homepage include A Short Hike, NORCO, DREDGE and Night in the Woods

facts.fact: Yarn Spinner says it makes tools for planning, writing, managing and delivering a game's dialogue and narrative.
Yarn Spinner runs in Unity, Godot (C# and GDScript) and Unreal Engine, with free and paid versions.
The homepage lists drafting, feedback, version control, localisation, voice-over and porting among the problems it handles.
Games listed as made with Yarn Spinner include A Short Hike, NORCO, DREDGE and Night in the Woods.

name: ink
what_it_is: inkle's open source narrative scripting language for branching interactive stories, with the Inky editor and a Unity plugin.
platforms: Inky editor for Mac, Windows and Linux; Unity plugin; Unreal container (Inkpot) by The Chinese Room
key_features: Inky editor with live play pane
notable: inkle says it has written millions of words of branching narrative in ink for its own games

facts.fact: ink is inkle's narrative scripting language for games, conceived as middleware that slots into a game engine.
ink, Inky and the ink-unity integration plugin are freely available under the MIT license.
Inky is an editor for Mac, Windows and Linux that plays stories as you write and exports to JSON or the web.
Unreal Engine integration comes from The Chinese Room as a container called Inkpot, not from inkle.

name: articy:draft X
what_it_is: A narrative design tool that works as a visual database for storylines, characters, variables and dialogue, with Unity and Unreal integrations.
pricing: Free version available; single-user and multi-user licenses are sold through a pricing page whose amounts were not readable in the opened text.
notable: Imprint names Articy Software GmbH & Co. KG, Germany

facts.fact: articy:draft X is described as a professional narrative design tool and a visual database for storylines, characters and variables.
articy:draft X is available for Microsoft Windows and macOS, and the page offers a free version.
The page lists ready-made integrations for Unity and Unreal, plus localization, flexible exports and an API.
The pricing options page splits offers into Multi-User and Single-User, and shows no amounts in the opened text.
The site footer names Articy Software GmbH & Co. KG, Germany.

name: Dialogue System for Unity
what_it_is: A Unity dialogue and quest asset family, including an OpenAI addon that connects conversations to language models.
platforms: Unity (sold through the Unity Asset Store)
pricing: Price is not shown on the opened pages; an evaluation version is offered for download.
key_features: Addon for OpenAI and Ollama models
notable: Studio testimonials include Torpor Games, developer of Suzerain, and ZA/UM, developer of Disco Elysium

facts.fact: Dialogue System for Unity is available on the Unity Asset Store, and an evaluation version can be downloaded.
The Pixel Crushers site lists addons for OpenAI, procedural dialogue and quests (Quest Machine).
The OpenAI addon requires Dialogue System for Unity 2.2.58 or later and, per its page, supports GPT-5, GPT-4o and models run through Ollama such as Llama 3.2 and 3.3, Deepseek and Gemma.
The site quotes Torpor Games (Suzerain) and ZA/UM (Disco Elysium) praising the Dialogue System.
